set: A: the whole site: the six pages at rest on one sheet, the screens with the controls, and sheets across one visitor's visit through the live site

issues.where: pinball sequence, mid sheet: frames 1:43.22/1:46.92 vs 1:50.62 onward
issues.what: the pinball table itself is rebuilt between frames: the first frames show a dark playfield with classic lanes, ramps, flippers and a gold 000000 scoreboard, then a few seconds later it is a different table entirely (three gray domes, office-desk props, no scoreboard, different perspective and flippers), and it changes again at 2:01.70. The level labels (Entry-Level, Company, Management's) suggest intentional progression, but inside one machine the wholesale redesign reads at play speed as the centerpiece swapping artwork mid-game rather than one continuous table
issues.fix: keep one consistent table chassis across the whole sequence (same outer rails, perspective and scoreboard position/style) and change only the playfield features per level, or add a clear in-fiction transition (ball draining into a new board) so the redesign reads as deliberate

issues.where: at-rest previews of pages 2 and 3 (and the form steps generally)
issues.what: pages 2 and 3 are the same kind of scene: same beige ground, same left-aligned step text, same grid of recessed form fields with the contraption below. Pages 5 and 6 break away, but two adjacent steps feeling interchangeable slightly flattens the run
issues.fix: differentiate one of pages 2/3's at-rest composition - e.g. give Step 2's rotary dial or Step 3's tube a presence in the at-rest state, or change the layout rhythm (split panel vs full-width console) so each step has its own silhouette

issues.what: at rest, page 4 is a large empty beige field with only the tube device, noticeably sparser than the other five at-rest states, though the fiction partly covers it
issues.fix: add a small at-rest element tied to the assessment (a dimmed scoreboard plaque, a warning stripe beside the tube) so the page matches the finish density of its neighbors
